Body.Content:
Orchestration playbooks can now re-evaluate the conditions every 5 seconds instead of every 30 seconds. With this shorter interval, you get finer control over priority escalation and Bullseye pool expansion. As a result, conversations reach the right queue or specialist sooner when wait times or queue status change.

GA date: October CY2026
